content: He who has conquered his own restless mind has conquered the three worlds.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Atmanam vijayeeta (आत्मानं सततं रक्षेत्) — Yoga Vasishtha & Gita Precepts
explanation: Alexander wept because he had no more worlds to conquer, yet he died in a fit of undisciplined fever. What use is planting flags across oceans if you are enslaved by your own lust, rage, greed, and terror? Self-mastery is the only throne that never falls.
practicalInsight: Practice conquering one minor craving or impulse today—skip that extra snack, resist checking your notifications for an hour.
reflectionPrompt: Are you striving to master external people and circumstances while remaining an absolute slave to your own moods?
